eq-ch11-dt-mul: A product with the device step equals the product with the host step bit for bit: both round the step to the tensor's dtype.
eq-ch11-dt-divide: On CUDA a quotient by the device step equals the quotient by the host step bit for bit: both multiply by the FP64 reciprocal rounded to the tensor's dtype.
eq-ch11-tile: A reconstruction line over 1024 cells is tiled; the tile starts at 256 and halves until its inputs, stencil halo and weights fit in 48 KiB of shared memory.
